name: Sand Mandala
desc: A radially symmetric sand mandala that constructs wedge-by-wedge from the center outward, holds, then dissolves in a wind sweep of blown grains, rendered as stippled Tibetan colored sand, black line rangoli, leaded stained glass, glowing neon, or a cyan compass-and-radius blueprint.

sym.doc: rotational symmetry / petal count per ring

hue.doc: base hue; ring hues fan out from it

style.doc: render philosophy: stippled colored sand / black line rangoli / leaded stained glass / neon glow / cyan compass-construction blueprint

act.doc: dramaturgy: build-hold-dissolve loop / build once and hold / always full & rotating
